title: Code review with a security eye: what to look for first

videos.script: A pull request arrives. Two new routes, a template change, a smaller requirements file. The description says it all works. {{arrives}} It does work. And any patient can now read any other patient's messages. {{works}} A security review is not reading the diff from top to bottom. It is asking five questions, in order. {{five}} Who may do this? What comes in? Where does it go out? What secrets changed? What dependencies changed? {{questions}} The first question is the hardest, because the answer is often a line that is not there. {{absent}} Today you review one real change, mark six findings, and write the comments that get them fixed. {{today}}
